title: OpTimatic
description: OpTimatic combines performance optimization with carefully selected quality-of-life features, delivering a smoother and more enjoyable Minecraft experience — updated to the latest version whenever possible, so you can play at your best from day one
body:
# Optimised Timely — OpTimatic

OpTimatic is a QOL-focused Minecraft modpack built to improve the overall gameplay experience through carefully selected quality-of-life and optimization mods.

The pack focuses primarily on usability improvements that make Minecraft smoother and more convenient to play, while still including performance optimizations to help the game run more efficiently. The goal is not to heavily modify Minecraft, but to refine the experience with tools and improvements that feel natural to use.

OpTimatic is a **client-side modpack**, meaning it does not change vanilla gameplay or server mechanics. You can join most vanilla or modded servers normally without requiring the server to install the pack.

The name *OpTimatic* comes from **Optimised** and **Timely**, reflecting the core philosophy behind the pack:

**Optimised** — a collection of mods chosen to improve stability, usability, and performance.  
**Timely** — kept up-to-date with the latest Minecraft versions whenever possible.

Because OpTimatic includes many quality-of-life features alongside optimization improvements, it is best suited for players with a **moderately capable system** rather than extremely low-end hardware.

If your main goal is **maximum FPS and the lightest possible setup**, you may want to try the lighter version of the pack instead:  [OpTimatic-Lite](https://modrinth.com/modpack/optimatic)

The goal is simple: provide a modern, convenient Minecraft client that improves the way the game feels to play while keeping the core vanilla experience intact.
